context: Tekla Structures, English, imperial units (feet-inches). The presenter models a column and two beams, then from about 00:57 adds component 142 'Two sided end plate' and fills its dialog (Picture, Plates, Bolts, ...).

pieces.ask: every profile name that is visible or spoken for the column and the two beams (property pane, labels, toolbar profile box, the narrator); whether the beams land on the column's flange or web; the parts picked for the 142.

the Picture tab boxes, the Plates tabs (end plate t, b, h for both plates), and the Bolts tab: bolt size, standard, tolerance, thread in material, site/shop, hole type, the vertical and horizontal references, edge distances, number of bolts and spacings.

every change to the Bolts tab (vertical and horizontal edge distance, number of bolts, spacing) with the Modify presses, the final values, the Apply / OK presses; the result in the model; the status bar text after the last Modify; the component symbol's colour.
